statement:
One can consider braids with even numbers of strands. Markov's moves
change the parity of the number of strands. Can one reformulate
Markov's theorem in such a way that only braids with even numbers of
strands take part in this formulation?
title: Virtual-knot problem 42 — One can consider braids with even numbers of strands.
